historical_record.description: A two-storey building of about 21,250 square feet over a basement was built here in 1927 as a garage, and was later a warehouse and a factory.
An existing approximately 21,250-square-foot, two-story warehouse stood at the property.
The City Planning Commission upheld the negative declaration for the proposed project.
The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization for development on the lot, as amended to unbundle the parking.

By the summer of 2006 the condominium project approved on condition that it keep the historic warehouse had left only the facade standing, with a rooftop penthouse larger than the approved plans; the Planning Department said the penthouse must be cut back before the building could be occupied.
This site previously held a public garage, operating by this date, when the Board of Supervisors transferred its permit to a new operator.
